<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0022026-05-2103-12-22" status="unreviewed">de la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4207">me dig pa</rs> na re 
         reg bya 'dzin pa'i blo kha dog la tshad mar 'gro ste reg bya dang kha dog gnyis bdag gcig tu nges pas so zhe na |
         yod pa 'dzin pa'i blo skad cig ma la tshad mar 'gro ste gnod pa can gyi rjes dpag gis yod pa las skad cig mas khyab par bsgrubs pas so ||
         de ltar na yod pa dang skad cig ma bdag gcig par dran nam ma dran ||
         dang po ltar na glo bur ba'i rjes dpag du 'gyur la | gnyis pa ltar na rgyu mtshan med pa'i yid dpyod du 'gyur ro zhe na|
         reg bya dang kha dog gnyis bdag gcig par dran nam ma dran |
         dang po ltar na log pa'i rgyu mtshan can gyi yid dpyod du 'gyur la |gnyis pa ltar na rgyu mtshan med pa'i yid dpyod du thal lo ||
         reg bya 'dzin pa'i shes pa kha dog la zhen pa 'dren pas tshad ma yin no zhe na |
         de lta na sngon po 'dzin pa'i mig gi rnam shes kyang rtag pa la tshad mar thal te yid kyi rnam par shes pa sngon po rtag pa'o zhen zhen pa 'dren pa'i phyir ro ||</seg></TEI>
